istum in me tuum conserves: studia etiam mea resq;
alias commendatas tibi habeas: quae quonam sint in
loco, ex eo, qui hasce tibi literas tradit, cognosces.

page.notes: Printed text is set in roman with some italic; the running head and heading are as printed. The first Greek word after ἀξιωλικὸν and the word παρακλητικὸν are uncertain and marked [?]. The second margin note has a doubtful hyphenated form at "dis-gens" (line break after "dis"), marked [?]. Long s has been normalised to s throughout. The page number "53" is read from a faint numeral and may be a 5 in old form. The word "repre-" at the foot ends a line with a hyphen and continues on the next page.
